scams.name: Pingyao Ancient City Ticket Bundle & 'Combo' Overcharge
scams.description: Pingyao Ancient City (平遥古城) is a UNESCO World Heritage 14th-century walled town. The official 'Ancient City Tongpiao' (通票) ticket is ¥125 per person — valid for 3 days, covers access to 20+ monuments inside including Rishengchang Exchange Shop (China's first bank), the Confucius Temple, the City Tower, Qing Dynasty government offices, and the ancient city walls. The scam variants: (1) third-party resellers online (WeChat / Facebook) sell 'skip-the-line Pingyao' tickets at ¥250–¥400 per person — there is no skip-the-line, the official queue is 2–5 minutes even in peak season; (2) hotel-concierge 'combo tickets' at ¥300–¥500 per person when the ¥125 Tongpiao covers everything; (3) 'VIP private guide + ticket' packages at ¥800 per person that deliver standard tour content at 3x cost. r/travelchina 'Travelling to China for 19 days. Need advice' (comments/24g5fu) documents the broader context: 'skip pingyao. it's a tourist trap. do hangzhou instead of suzhou' — framing Pingyao's tourist-trap reputation among seasoned China travelers. r/chinatravel 'China Travel' (new posts 2025) documents ongoing tourist-scam concerns. r/solotravel 'For those who have travel to both China and India' (comments/f84cl4) confirms: 'At first, Pingyao also greatly interested me, but we took it' — meaning many travelers do visit, but the scam ecosystem around packaged tours is well-documented. For older travelers interested in Pingyao (the UNESCO heritage is genuinely worth seeing despite its 'tourist trap' reputation), the clean route: (1) take the Taiyuan-Pingyao train (¥23 for the 1.5-hour high-speed rail from Taiyuan South, or ¥7.5 for the slow local train, 1h45m); (2) buy Pingyao Ancient City Tongpiao (¥125) at the South Gate ticket office or via Trip.com / Ctrip; (3) the Tongpiao covers 3 days and all 20+ monuments — no 'combo' or 'VIP' needed; (4) walk the 6 km ancient city walls (included in Tongpiao, entrance at North Gate or South Gate); (5) avoid hotel-concierge ticket packages over ¥200 per person — all are commission markups.
scams.avoidance: Taiyuan-Pingyao high-speed rail ¥23 (1.5h) or slow train ¥7.5 (1h45m) Pingyao Tongpiao (¥125) at South Gate ticket office or via Trip.com / Ctrip Tongpiao covers 3 days + all 20+ monuments — no 'combo' or 'VIP' needed Walk 6 km ancient city walls (included) from North or South Gate Avoid hotel-concierge packages over ¥200 per person
scams.location: Pingyao Ancient City walls and gates, official ticket office at the South Gate, 'combo ticket' resellers, hotel-concierge ticket desks

scams.name: Pingyao Silk 'Museum' & Ancient Currency Shop Pressure Sales
scams.description: Pingyao's main tourist strip (South Street running from South Gate to North Gate) has multiple commission-driven 'museum shops' disguised as historical exhibitions. The most aggressive: (1) 'Pingyao Silk Workshop' offers a 10-min 'traditional silk-reeling demonstration' followed by 60–90 min of pressure sales for silk quilts (¥3,000–¥15,000), scarves (¥500–¥2,000), and bedding sets at 3–5x residential rates; (2) 'Ancient Chinese Currency Museum' leads visitors through fake 'historical' currency displays then pressures ¥500–¥5,000 purchases of 'rare ancient coin collections' that are modern reproductions; (3) 'Shanxi Black Vinegar Distillery' similarly packages commercial products as 'traditional family recipes' at ¥200–¥800 per bottle. r/China 'Government facilities in travel tour scams? (Jade, TCM)' (comments/1hfcgv5, 2024) applies the canonical shopping-stop anchor — Pingyao has its own specialized versions. r/travelchina 'Are tours in China still sketchy and make you go shopping?' (comments/1k85j1d, 2025) confirms 2025 continuation. r/travelchina 'Travelling to China for 19 days. Need advice' (comments/24g5fu) places Pingyao on the 'skip it' list partly because of this scam density. For older travelers in Pingyao, the practical rule: (1) SKIP all 'museum' venues on South Street that include product demonstrations — the historical content is usually available for free elsewhere; (2) Rishengchang Exchange Shop (included in Tongpiao) is the GENUINE historical bank museum — no sales pressure, posted exhibitions; (3) Shuanglin Temple (20 km outside Pingyao, ¥35 entry via bus ¥15) is a genuine Ming Dynasty Buddhist temple — skip 'silk workshop' stops on the bus route; (4) for authentic Shanxi vinegar, residential supermarkets sell brand-name Shuita (水塔) or Dongxing (东兴) at ¥20–¥60 per bottle; (5) if you want silk as a souvenir, visit Suzhou Silk Museum (Renmin Road) or shop online at Taobao.com for genuine Jiangsu silk at 1/3 to 1/10 Pingyao tour-stop prices.
scams.avoidance: SKIP 'museum' venues on South Street with demonstrations Rishengchang Exchange Shop (included in Tongpiao) is the genuine bank museum Shuanglin Temple (20 km away, ¥35) is genuine Ming Buddhist — bus ¥15, skip silk-stops Shanxi vinegar: supermarket Shuita or Dongxing ¥20–¥60 per bottle For silk, go to Suzhou Silk Museum or Taobao rather than Pingyao workshops
scams.location: Pingyao Ancient City South Street (the main tourist strip), Shuanglin Temple approach, tour-bus drop-off shopping venues

scams.name: Pingyao Guesthouse Overcharge & Off-Platform Booking Fraud
scams.description: Pingyao's signature accommodation is the traditional Qing-Dynasty courtyard guesthouse (siheyuan-style) inside the ancient city walls. Legitimate rates: ¥150–¥300/night for basic double room in an authentic courtyard; ¥400–¥800/night for boutique refurbished courtyards. Scam variants: (1) 'WeChat direct booking' from a stranger met in Taiyuan or Pingyao bus station claiming 'better rate than Booking.com' — the 'hotel' either doesn't exist or is a lower-quality property; (2) on-arrival guesthouse upcharge — booked ¥200/night becomes '¥400 with tax and service' at check-in; (3) 'courtyard upgrade' for ¥100+ that's actually a different room of the same class. r/chinalife 'I've learned about these two scams in China in 2024' (comments/1ds004e, 2024) applies the universal booking-scam rule. For older travelers considering Pingyao accommodation: (1) book only through Booking.com, Agoda, or Trip.com with platform-verified payment and cancellation protection; (2) refuse any off-platform 'WeChat direct' or 'better rate' offers from strangers; (3) on arrival, verify the booking confirmation matches what you pay at check-in — screenshot any discrepancies; (4) refuse 'courtyard upgrade' pitches; (5) for authentic Pingyao courtyard experience at fair price, community-recommended names: Harmony Guesthouse (¥180–¥300), Yide Hotel (¥200–¥400), Jing's Residence (boutique, ¥600–¥1,000 — legitimate upscale).
scams.avoidance: Book only through Booking.com, Agoda, or Trip.com with platform payment Refuse off-platform 'WeChat direct' offers from strangers Verify check-in rate matches booking; screenshot discrepancies Community names: Harmony Guesthouse (¥180–¥300), Yide Hotel (¥200–¥400), Jing's Residence (¥600–¥1,000) Reject 'courtyard upgrade' pitches at check-in
scams.location: Pingyao Ancient City guesthouses (traditional courtyard (kèzhàn / sìhéyuàn)), online booking platforms, WeChat direct-booking referrals

scams.name: Pingyao Noodle & Shanxi Cuisine Tourist-Menu Overcharge
scams.description: Pingyao and Shanxi province are famous for hand-cut noodles (daoxiao mian 刀削面, pulled noodles, braised beef noodles). Residential rates: ¥15–¥30 per bowl. Tourist-strip South Street restaurants charge ¥50–¥100 per bowl for the same noodles with laminated English-photo menus. Pingyao beef (one of the 'Three Famous Foods of Pingyao') at tourist venues is ¥120–¥200 per plate vs ¥40–¥80 at residential restaurants. For older travelers, the practical guide: (1) walk one block off South Street for residential Shanxi noodle shops; community favourites include Deju Yuan Noodle (¥18–¥30 per bowl), Yun Jin Cheng Noodle Shop (¥15–¥25), Xiangtie Tang (¥25–¥40 with side dishes); (2) for Pingyao beef, the historical institution is Pingyao Guanyun Beef Company flagship store (¥50–¥100 per plate, authentic); (3) avoid any restaurant with English-speaking tout outside or laminated English-photo menus; (4) book via Dianping (Chinese Yelp) with 4.5+ ratings.
scams.avoidance: Walk one block off South Street for residential Shanxi noodles Community favourites: Deju Yuan Noodle (¥18–¥30), Yun Jin Cheng (¥15–¥25) For Pingyao beef: Pingyao Guanyun Beef Company flagship (¥50–¥100 authentic) Use Dianping (4.5+ ratings) Avoid English-photo menu restaurants on tourist strip
scams.location: South Street tourist strip restaurants, tourist-facing Shanxi cuisine venues near ancient city gates

scams.name: Taiyuan to Pingyao Transit & Tout Scams
scams.description: Most Pingyao visitors arrive via Taiyuan (capital of Shanxi, the main high-speed rail hub). The legitimate connections: Taiyuan South (or Taiyuan Railway Station) to Pingyao high-speed rail ¥23 (1.5h); or slow local train ¥7.5 (1h45m). From Pingyao Railway Station to the Ancient City South Gate is 2.5 km — walkable 25 min or ¥10–¥15 taxi. The scam variants: (1) taxi touts at Taiyuan South quote ¥300–¥500 'private car to Pingyao' when the train is ¥7.5–¥23; (2) Pingyao Railway Station taxis quote ¥80–¥150 for the 2.5 km trip (legitimate ¥10–¥15); (3) 'Pingyao shuttle bus' touts at Taiyuan airport sell ¥100 'direct transfer' that's the regular ¥30 shuttle at markup. r/travelchina 'Taxi drivers in China airports and train station' (comments/1ks12o9, 2025) applies the universal China-wide rule at Taiyuan and Pingyao stations. For older travelers, the practical playbook: (1) book Taiyuan-Pingyao high-speed rail (¥23) via Trip.com or 12306.cn; (2) at Pingyao Railway Station, walk to Ancient City South Gate (2.5 km, 25 min via well-signed street) or use DiDi / local taxi with 'da biao' expect ¥10–¥15; (3) if you arrive at Taiyuan Wusu Airport (TYN), take the high-speed rail from Taiyuan South rather than a taxi 'direct transfer'; (4) photograph taxi plate before boarding any cab; (5) reject all tout 'private car' offers at Taiyuan stations.
scams.avoidance: Taiyuan-Pingyao high-speed rail ¥23 (1.5h) via Trip.com or 12306.cn Pingyao Railway Station to Ancient City: walk 2.5 km (25 min) or taxi ¥10–¥15 with 'da biao' From Taiyuan airport, use high-speed rail from Taiyuan South, not 'direct transfer' Photograph taxi plate before boarding Reject all tout 'private car' offers at Taiyuan stations
scams.location: Taiyuan South Railway Station arrivals, Taiyuan Bus Station, Pingyao Railway Station, Pingyao Ancient City South Gate approach
